## Load the 10X derived sequences

```{r loading, echo=FALSE, include=TRUE, warning=FALSE}
E70.data <- Read10X(filepath_macos)
E70.ADT <- E70.data$`Antibody Capture`
Cells(E70.ADT) %>% length()
# Create Seurat Object using gene expression as main data
E70 = CreateSeuratObject(counts = E70.data$`Gene Expression`, project = "E70", min.cells = 3, min.features = 200)
# Create "Assay" of the Hashtags and Barcode Oligos
E70[["ADT"]] <- CreateAssayObject(E70.data[["Antibody Capture"]][, colnames(x = E70)])

DefaultAssay(E70) <- "ADT"

```

## HTO Hashtag Demultiplex

```{r HTODemultiplex, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=TRUE, eval=TRUE}
# TotalSeqC Hashtag HTO demultiuplexig
E70.ADT <- t(E70.ADT)
E70.ADT <- as.matrix(E70.ADT)
E70.ADT.Hash <- E70.ADT[, c(4, 5, 6)]
E70.ADT.Hash <- E70.ADT.Hash[rowSums(E70.ADT.Hash^2)>0,]
E70.ADT.Hash <- t(E70.ADT.Hash)

E70.ADT.Hash.sparse <- as(E70.ADT.Hash, "sparseMatrix")

E70.ADT.seurat <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = E70.ADT.Hash.sparse, project = "E70", assay = "ADT")
E70_ADT <- NormalizeData(E70.ADT.seurat, normalization.method = 'CLR', margin = 1)


E70.demux <- HTODemux(E70_ADT, assay = "ADT", positive.quantile = 0.99)

E70.demux <- subset(E70.demux, cells = Cells(E70))
length(Cells(E70))
length(Cells(E70.demux))


E70@meta.data[["Hashtag"]] <- E70.demux@meta.data[["ADT_maxID"]]
saveRDS(E70, file = paste(output_macos, 'E70_HashtagDemux.rds', sep = ''))

E70_Hashtag_df <- data.frame(Barcode = Cells(E70.demux), Hashtag = E70@meta.data[["Hashtag"]])
write.csv(E70_Hashtag_df, file = paste(output_macos, "E70_Hashtags.csv", sep = ""))


remove(E70.ADT.dCODE, E70.ADT.dCODE.seurat, E70.ADT.dCODE.sparse, E70.ADT.Hash, E70.ADT.Hash.sparse, E70.ADT.seurat, E70.demux, E70.demux.dCODE, E70_ADT, E70.data, E70.ADT)
gc()

```

## 

## Preprocessing of the Gene expression (GEX) data

```{r GEX, echo=FALSE, include=TRUE, eval=TRUE, warning=FALSE}
# Filter out based on feature counts
E70 <- subset(E70, subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 & nFeature_RNA < 6500)
#E70
E70[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(E70, pattern = "^MT-")
VlnPlot(E70, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"), ncol = 3)
E70 <- subset(E70, subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 & nFeature_RNA < 6500 & percent.mt < 5)

#~~~GENE EXPRESSION~~~
DefaultAssay(E70) <- "RNA"

# Normalize GEX data
E70_GEX <- NormalizeData(E70, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)

remove(E70)
# Find highgly variable features, unsure whether this is even useful here?
E70_GEX <- FindVariableFeatures(E70_GEX, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)

# scale data
all.genes <- rownames(E70_GEX)
E70_GEX <- ScaleData(E70_GEX, features = all.genes)

# Run the PCA based on the GEX
E70_GEX <- RunPCA(E70_GEX, features = VariableFeatures(object = E70_GEX))

# Find dimensionality of GEX dataset
Elbow <- ElbowPlot(E70_GEX, ndims = 50, reduction = "pca")

# Clustering and...
E70_GEX <- FindNeighbors(E70_GEX, dims = 1:10)
E70_GEX <- FindClusters(E70_GEX, resolution = 0.5)

# ...Run UMAP with dimensionality based on Elbowplot above
E70_GEX <- RunUMAP(E70_GEX, dims = 1:10)

gc()
# Doubletfinder
sweep.E70_GEX <- paramSweep(E70_GEX, PCs = 1:15, sct = T)
sweep.E70_GEX <- summarizeSweep(sweep.E70_GEX, GT = F)
bcmvn_E70_GEX <- find.pK(sweep.E70_GEX)
pk_E70_GEX <- bcmvn_E70_GEX %>% filter(BCmetric == max(BCmetric)) %>% select(pK)
pk_E70_GEX <- as.numeric(as.character(pk_E70_GEX[[1]]))
(ggplot(bcmvn_E70_GEX, aes(pK, BCmetric, group = 1)) + geom_point() + geom_line() + theme_classic())

annotations_E70_GEX <- E70_GEX@meta.data$seurat_clusters
homo.prop_E70_GEX <- modelHomotypic(annotations_E70_GEX)
nExp_poi_E70_GEX <- round(0.08*nrow(E70_GEX@meta.data))
nExp_poi.adj_E70_GEX <- round(nExp_poi_E70_GEX*(1-homo.prop_E70_GEX))

E70_GEX <- doubletFinder(E70_GEX, PCs = 1:15, pN = 0.25, pK = pk_E70_GEX, nExp = nExp_poi_E70_GEX, reuse.pANN = F, sct = T)

length(Cells(E70_GEX))
E70_GEX <- subset(E70_GEX, cells=rownames(E70_GEX@meta.data)[which(E70_GEX@meta.data$DF.classification == "Singlet")])
length(Cells(E70_GEX))

saveRDS(E70_GEX, file = paste(output_macos, 'E70_GEX_doubletremoval.rds', sep = ""))

remove(sweep.E70_GEX, bcmvn_E70_GEX, Elbow)
gc()
# ~~~ Re-process the data after doublet removal ~~~
E70_GEX <- readRDS(file = paste(output_macos, 'E70_GEX_doubletremoval.rds', sep = ""))
plan("multisession", workers = 1)

# Normalize GEX data
E70_GEX <- NormalizeData(E70_GEX, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)

# Find highgly variable features, unsure whether this is even useful here?
E70_GEX <- FindVariableFeatures(E70_GEX, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)

# scale data
all.genes <- rownames(E70_GEX)
E70_GEX <- ScaleData(E70_GEX, features = all.genes)

# Run the PCA based on the GEX
E70_GEX <- RunPCA(E70_GEX, features = VariableFeatures(object = E70_GEX))

# Find dimensionality of GEX dataset
Elbow <- ElbowPlot(E70_GEX, ndims = 50, reduction = "pca")

# Clustering and...
E70_GEX <- FindNeighbors(E70_GEX, dims = 1:10)

# ...Run UMAP with dimensionality based on Elbowplot above
E70_GEX <- RunUMAP(E70_GEX, dims = 1:9)
length(Cells(E70_GEX))

E70_GEX <- FindClusters(E70_GEX, resolution = 0.05) #Good resotion for 5 clusters

E70_GEX[["old.idents"]] <- Idents(object = E70_GEX)
DimPlot(E70_GEX)
E70_GEX <- RenameIdents(E70_GEX, '0'='GCBC 1', '1' = 'GCBC (G2-M cell cycle)', '2'="Circulating B cells", "3"="PreMBC", '4'="Plasma Blast")
DimPlot(E70_GEX)

saveRDS(E70_GEX, file = paste(output_macos, 'E70_GEX_temp.rds', sep = ""))
E70_GEX <- readRDS(file = paste(output_macos, 'E70_GEX_temp.rds', sep = ""))

DefaultAssay(E70_GEX) <- "RNA"


ggsave(filename = paste(output_macos, "E70_heatmap.svg", sep = ''))

remove(E70_GEX.markers, top20_E70_GEX)

saveRDS(E70_GEX, file = paste(output_macos, 'E70-GEX-Finished.rds', sep = ''))

```

## Continue with the processing of Hashtag/Barcode (ADT) data

```{r ADT, echo=FALSE, include=FALSE, warning=FALSE, eval=TRUE}
#E70_GEX <- readRDS(file = paste(output_macos, 'E70-GEX-Finished.rds', sep = ''))
DefaultAssay(E70_GEX) <- "ADT"
FeaturePlot(E70_GEX, features = E70_dCODE)

# Normalize ADT data
E70_ADT <- NormalizeData(E70_GEX, normalization.method = 'CLR', margin = 2)

# Find highly variable features, unsure whether this is even useful here?
E70_ADT <- FindVariableFeatures(E70_ADT, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)
length(Cells(E70_ADT))

# scale data
all.genes <- rownames(E70_ADT@assays[["ADT"]])
E70_ADT <- ScaleData(E70_ADT, features = all.genes)

# Run the PCA based on the ADT
E70_ADT <- RunPCA(E70_ADT, features = all.genes)

# Find dimensionality of ADT dataset
Elbow <- ElbowPlot(E70_ADT, ndims = 50, reduction = "pca")
Elbow

E70_ADT <- RunUMAP(E70_ADT, assay = 'ADT', dims = 1:5 )
DimPlot(E70_ADT)
DimPlot(E70_ADT, group.by = "Hashtag")
FeaturePlot(E70_ADT, features = E70_group)
# Clustering and...→
E70_ADT <- FindNeighbors(E70_ADT, dims = 1:5)

#clustree(E70_ADT)
E70_ADT <- FindClusters(E70_ADT, resolution = 0.01) #Maybe good cluster amount??
E70_ADT <- RenameIdents(E70_ADT, '0'='CA07', '1' = 'PR8', '2'='CA07-PR8')
E70_ADT@meta.data[["Hashtag"]] <- E70_ADT@active.ident
E70_GEX@meta.data[["Hashtag"]] <- E70_ADT@active.ident
length(Cells(E70_ADT))

ADT_plot <- DimPlot(E70_ADT, pt.size = 0.2, group.by = "Hashtag") + theme(aspect.ratio=1)
ADT_plot <- ADT_plot + ggtitle('Hashtag/Bardoce clustering')
ADT_plot
ggsave(filename = paste(output_macos, 'E70-ADT-Cluster.svg', sep = ''), ADT_plot)

plot2 <- FeaturePlot(E70_ADT, features = E70_dCODE, pt.size = 0.2, keep.scale = 'all', order = TRUE) & theme(aspect.ratio = 1)
plot2

p3 <- FeaturePlot(E70_ADT, features = E70_group, pt.size = 0.2, order = TRUE) &theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 6), axis.title = element_blank(), axis.text = element_blank())+theme(aspect.ratio=1)
p3

saveRDS(E70_ADT, file = paste(output_macos, 'E70-ADT-Finished.rds', sep = ''))

```

## Adding contigs from MiXCR

```{r MiXCR, echo=FALSE, include=TRUE, eval=TRUE, warning=FALSE}
E70_ADT <- readRDS(file = paste(output_macos, 'E70-ADT-Finished.rds', sep = ''))
E70_GEX <- readRDS(file = paste(output_macos, 'E70-GEX-Finished.rds', sep = ''))
length(Cells(E70_GEX))
length(Cells(E70_ADT))

#Loading Contig file
E70_contigs <- read.csv(file = "/Users/eliastjarnhage/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-UniversitetetiOslo/Documents/Research/10X_files/mouse_scseq_E70_contigs.txt", header = TRUE, sep = "\t" )

E70_clonotypes <- E70_contigs

# Renaming MiXCR contig output to match 10X cellranger filtered contig annotations
E70_clonotypes <- E70_clonotypes %>% 
  mutate(chain = E70_clonotypes$chains) %>% 
  mutate(barcode = paste(E70_clonotypes$tagValueCELL, "-1", sep = "")) %>% 
  mutate(reads = E70_clonotypes$readCount) %>% 
  mutate(v_gene = E70_clonotypes$bestVGene) %>% 
  mutate(d_gene = E70_clonotypes$bestDGene) %>% 
  mutate(j_gene = E70_clonotypes$bestJGene) %>% 
  mutate(c_gene = E70_clonotypes$bestCGene)

colnames(E70_clonotypes)[colnames(E70_clonotypes) == "nSeqFR1"] = "fwr1_nt"
colnames(E70_clonotypes)[colnames(E70_clonotypes) == "nSeqFR2"] = "fwr2_nt"
colnames(E70_clonotypes)[colnames(E70_clonotypes) == "nSeqFR3"] = "fwr3_nt"
colnames(E70_clonotypes)[colnames(E70_clonotypes) == "nSeqFR4"] = "fwr4_nt"

colnames(E70_clonotypes)[colnames(E70_clonotypes) == "nSeqCDR1"] = "cdr1_nt"
colnames(E70_clonotypes)[colnames(E70_clonotypes) == "nSeqCDR2"] = "cdr2_nt"
colnames(E70_clonotypes)[colnames(E70_clonotypes) == "nSeqCDR3"] = "cdr3_nt"

colnames(E70_clonotypes)[colnames(E70_clonotypes) == "aaSeqFR1"] = "fwr1"
colnames(E70_clonotypes)[colnames(E70_clonotypes) == "aaSeqFR2"] = "fwr2"
colnames(E70_clonotypes)[colnames(E70_clonotypes) == "aaSeqFR3"] = "fwr3"
colnames(E70_clonotypes)[colnames(E70_clonotypes) == "aaSeqFR4"] = "fwr4"

colnames(E70_clonotypes)[colnames(E70_clonotypes) == "aaSeqCDR1"] = "cdr1"
colnames(E70_clonotypes)[colnames(E70_clonotypes) == "aaSeqCDR2"] = "cdr2"
colnames(E70_clonotypes)[colnames(E70_clonotypes) == "aaSeqCDR3"] = "cdr3"

colnames(E70_clonotypes)[colnames(E70_clonotypes) == "uniqueUMICount"] = "umis"

colnames(E70_clonotypes)[colnames(E70_clonotypes) == "targetSequences"] = "length"

length(Cells(E70_ADT))

E70_clonotypes <- E70_clonotypes %>% group_by(barcode) %>% arrange(chain) %>% mutate(contig_id=paste(barcode, "_contig_", row_number(), sep = ""))

#11.12.2025 Write CSV file of clonotypes
write_csv(E70_clonotypes, file = paste(output_macos, "11.12.2025_E70_clonotypes.csv", sep = ""))


length(Cells(E70_ADT))
#Adding contig BCR information to ADT seurat object
contig.list <- createHTOContigList(E70_clonotypes, E70_ADT, group.by = "orig.ident")
length(Cells(E70_ADT))

combined <- combineBCR(contig.list, sample = "", threshold = 0.85, removeNA = TRUE)
combined[[1]][["barcode"]] <- gsub("_", "", combined[[1]][["barcode"]])

E70_ADT_combined_true <- combineExpression(combined, E70_ADT, 
                  cloneCall="aa", 
                  group.by = "none", 
                  proportion = FALSE,
                  filterNA = TRUE, #If this is TRUE then half the cells disapear
                  cloneSize=c(Single=1, Small=5, Medium=20, Large=100, Hyperexpanded=500))

# Asigning colors
grid.cols.ADT <- scales::hue_pal()(length(unique(E70_ADT_combined_true@active.ident)))
names(grid.cols.ADT) <- levels(E70_ADT_combined_true@active.ident)

slot(E70_ADT_combined_true, "meta.data")$cloneType <- factor(slot(E70_ADT_combined_true, "meta.data")$cloneSize,
                levels = c("Hyperexpanded (100 < X <= 500)",
                           "Large (20 < X <= 100)",
                            "Medium (5 < X <= 20)",
                            "Small (1 < X <= 5)",
                            "Single (0 < X <= 1)", NA))

length(Cells(E70_ADT))
length(Cells(E70_ADT_combined_true))
saveRDS(E70_ADT_combined_true, file = paste(output_macos, 'E70-ADT-Finished-clonotypes.rds', sep = ''))


#Adding contig BCR information to GEX seurat object
contig.list <- createHTOContigList(E70_clonotypes, E70_GEX, group.by = "orig.ident")


combined <- combineBCR(contig.list, sample = "", threshold = 0.85)

combined[[1]][["barcode"]] <- gsub("_", "", combined[[1]][["barcode"]])

E70_GEX <- combineExpression(combined, E70_GEX, 
                  cloneCall="aa", 
                  group.by = "none", 
                  proportion = FALSE,
                  filterNA = TRUE,
                  cloneSize=c(Single=1, Small=5, Medium=20, Large=100, Hyperexpanded=500))

# Asigning colors
grid.cols.GEX <- scales::hue_pal()(length(unique(E70_GEX@active.ident)))
names(grid.cols.GEX) <- levels(E70_GEX@active.ident)

slot(E70_GEX, "meta.data")$cloneType <- factor(slot(E70_GEX, "meta.data")$cloneSize, 
                levels = c("Hyperexpanded (100 < X <= 500)", 
                           "Large (20 < X <= 100)", 
                            "Medium (5 < X <= 20)", 
                            "Small (1 < X <= 5)", 
                            "Single (0 < X <= 1)", NA))

length(Cells(E70_GEX))
length(Cells(E70_ADT))
saveRDS(E70_GEX, file = paste(output_macos, 'E70-GEX-Finished-clonotypes.rds', sep = ''))
# Highlighting clonotypes


## Renaming to IMGT gene names - Contig file

IMGT_IGH <- read.csv(file = "/Users/eliastjarnhage/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-UniversitetetiOslo/Documents/Research/10X_files/OGRDB_IGH.csv", header = TRUE )

IMGT_IGKJ <- read.csv(file = "/Users/eliastjarnhage/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-UniversitetetiOslo/Documents/Research/10X_files/OGRDB_IGKJ.csv", header = TRUE )
IMGT_IGLJ <- read.csv(file = "/Users/eliastjarnhage/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-UniversitetetiOslo/Documents/Research/10X_files/OGRDB_IGLJ.csv", header = TRUE )

E70_contigs$IMGT_VGene = E70_contigs$bestVGene
E70_contigs$IMGT_DGene = E70_contigs$bestDGene
E70_contigs$IMGT_JGene = E70_contigs$bestJGene

for (index in 1:nrow(E70_contigs)) {
  #print(paste("index:",index))
  if (E70_contigs$IMGT_VGene[index] != FALSE) {
    table_row <- which(grepl(E70_contigs$bestVGene[index], IMGT_table$Label, fixed = TRUE))
    #print(IMGT_table$IMGT.Name[table_row])
    if (IMGT_table$IMGT.Name[table_row] != "") {
      E70_contigs$IMGT_VGene[index] <- IMGT_table$IMGT.Name[table_row]
    } else {
      E70_contigs$IMGT_VGene[index] <- IMGT_table$Alt.Names[table_row]

  }
}
```

```{r dCODE, echo=FALSE, include=TRUE, eval=TRUE, warning=FALSE}
#Load processed RDS files if not already loaded
E70_ADT <- readRDS(file = paste(output_macos, 'E70-ADT-Finished-clonotypes.rds', sep = ''))
E70_GEX <- readRDS(file = paste(output_macos, 'E70-GEX-Finished-clonotypes.rds', sep = ''))

grid.cols.ADT <- scales::hue_pal()(length(unique(E70_ADT@active.ident)))
names(grid.cols.ADT) <- levels(E70_ADT@active.ident)

DoHeatmap(E70_ADT, features = c("OVA", "CA07", "PR8"))

#Check and filter out which cells are OVA binders based on exrepssion
OVAcells <- WhichCells(E70_ADT, expression = OVA > 0.5) #144 cells are OVA binders
E70_dCODE_csv <- data.frame(barcode = WhichCells(E70_ADT, expression = OVA > 0.5), AgBinding = "OVA")

FeatureScatter(E70_ADT, "CA07", "OVA") +

    theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 12),

    theme(aspect.ratio=1)
FeatureScatter(E70_ADT, "PR8", "OVA") +

    theme(aspect.ratio=1)

#Remove OVA binding cells
E70_ADT.noOVA <- subset(E70_ADT, OVA < 0.5)


#Label cells based on quadrant "gating"
CAcells <- WhichCells(E70_ADT.noOVA, expression = CA07 >= 0.8 & PR8 < 0.25)
PR8cells <- WhichCells(E70_ADT.noOVA, expression = CA07 < 0.8 & PR8 >= 0.25)
Crosscells <- WhichCells(E70_ADT.noOVA, expression = CA07 >= 0.81 & PR8 >= 0.251)
Negcells <- WhichCells(E70_ADT.noOVA, expression = CA07 < 0.8 & PR8 < 0.25)
FeatureScatter(E70_ADT, "CA07", "PR8")


E70_ADT.noOVA$AgGate <- "test"
E70_ADT.noOVA$AgGate <- ifelse(colnames(E70_ADT.noOVA) %in% Crosscells, "Cross", 
                          ifelse(colnames(E70_ADT.noOVA) %in% PR8cells, "PR8",
                                 ifelse(colnames(E70_ADT.noOVA) %in% CAcells, "CA07",
                                        "Negative")))

E70_ADT.noOVA$AgGate1 <- ifelse(colnames(E70_ADT.noOVA) %in% CAcells, "CA07", E70_ADT.noOVA$AgGate)
E70_ADT.noOVA$AgGate1 <- ifelse(colnames(E70_ADT.noOVA) %in% PR8cells, "PR8", E70_ADT.noOVA$AgGate)
E70_ADT.noOVA$AgGate1 <- ifelse(colnames(E70_ADT.noOVA) %in% Crosscells, "Cross", E70_ADT.noOVA$AgGate)
E70_ADT.noOVA$AgGate1 <- ifelse(colnames(E70_ADT.noOVA) %in% Negcells, "Negative", E70_ADT.noOVA$AgGate)

FeatureScatter(E70_ADT.noOVA, "CA07", "PR8", group.by = "AgGate") +
    theme(plot.title = element_blank()) & 
    theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 12), 
        axis.text = element_text(size = 10)) &
    theme(aspect.ratio=1)


ggsave(plot = FeatureScatter(E70_ADT.noOVA, "CA07", "PR8", jitter = TRUE, log = TRUE) +
        theme(plot.title = element_blank()) +

              axis.text = element_text(size = 10)) +
        theme(aspect.ratio=1),
    filename = paste(output_macos, "E70_HA_featureScatterLog.svg", sep = "")
)

ggsave(plot =
RidgePlot(E70_ADT.noOVA, "CA07", idents = c("CA07", "PR8")) +
RidgePlot(E70_ADT.noOVA, "PR8", idents = c("CA07", "PR8")),
filename = paste(output_macos, "E70_HA_featureRidge.svg", sep = "")
)
length(Cells(subset(subset(E70_ADT.noOVA, CA07 > 0.75), idents = "PR8" ))) / 
length(Cells(subset(E70_ADT.noOVA, idents = "PR8" )))

length(Cells(subset(subset(E70_ADT.noOVA, CA07 > 0.75), idents = "CA07" ))) / 
length(Cells(subset(E70_ADT.noOVA, idents = "CA07" )))

length(Cells(subset(subset(E70_ADT.noOVA, PR8 > 0.3), idents = "CA07" ))) /
length(Cells(subset(E70_ADT.noOVA, idents = "CA07" )))

length(Cells(subset(subset(E70_ADT.noOVA, PR8 > 0.3), idents = "PR8" ))) /
length(Cells(subset(E70_ADT.noOVA, idents = "PR8" )))

#Adjust binders where the same clonotype have been asigned as both cross-reactive and specific for a single HA
clonalOverlap(E70_ADT.noOVA, cloneCall = "CTaa", group.by = "AgGate", method = "overlap", exportTable = TRUE)

# Claude AI replacement code for deprecated scRepertoire "expression2list" which the code was reliant on
meta <- E70_ADT.noOVA[[]]
lst  <- split(meta, meta$AgGate)
# Drop cells without a clonotype, as expression2List did
combined2 <- lapply(lst, function(x) x[!is.na(x$CTaa), ])

overlapCA07_Cross <- intersect(combined2[["CA07"]][["CTaa"]], combined2[["Cross"]][["CTaa"]])
overlapPR8_Cross <- intersect(combined2[["PR8"]][["CTaa"]], combined2[["Cross"]][["CTaa"]])
overlapCA07_Neg <- intersect(combined2[["CA07"]][["CTaa"]], combined2[["Negative"]][["CTaa"]])
overlapCA07_PR8 <- intersect(combined2[["CA07"]][["CTaa"]], combined2[["PR8"]][["CTaa"]])


overlapCA07_Cross %in% overlapPR8_Cross
overlapCA07_Cross %in% overlapCA07_Neg
overlapCA07_Neg %in% overlapPR8_Cross

E70_ADT.noOVA$AgGate2 <- E70_ADT.noOVA$AgGate
E70_ADT.noOVA$AgGate2 <- ifelse(E70_ADT.noOVA@meta.data[["CTaa"]] %in% overlapCA07_Cross, "Overlap", E70_ADT.noOVA$AgGate)
E70_ADT.noOVA$AgGate2 <- ifelse(E70_ADT.noOVA@meta.data[["CTaa"]] %in% overlapPR8_Cross, "Overlap", E70_ADT.noOVA$AgGate)
E70_ADT.noOVA$AgGate2 <- ifelse(E70_ADT.noOVA@meta.data[["CTaa"]] %in% overlapCA07_PR8, "Overlap", E70_ADT.noOVA$AgGate)

"Overlap" %in% E70_ADT.noOVA@meta.data[["AgGate2"]]

E70_dCODE_csv3 <- data.frame(barcode = Cells(subset(E70_ADT.noOVA)), AgBinding = E70_ADT.noOVA@meta.data[["AgGate2"]])
E70_dCODE_csv <- E70_dCODE_csv %>% bind_rows(

)
write.csv(E70_dCODE_csv, file = paste(output_macos, "E70_HA_ASSIGNMENTS.csv", sep = ""), row.names = TRUE)

row_count <- as.data.frame(x = table(E70_ADT.noOVA$AgGate2))

E70_ADT.noOVA.noOverlap <- subset(E70_ADT.noOVA, AgGate2 != "Overlap")

length(Cells(E70_GEX))

E70_GEX.noOVA@meta.data[["HA_binding"]] = E70_ADT.noOVA.noOverlap@meta.data[["AgGate2"]]
E70_ADT.noOVA.noOverlap@meta.data[["HA_binding"]] = E70_ADT.noOVA.noOverlap@meta.data[["AgGate2"]]

saveRDS(E70_ADT.noOVA.noOverlap, file = paste(output_macos, 'E70-ADT-Finished-NoOVA.rds', sep = ''))
saveRDS(E70_GEX.noOVA, file = paste(output_macos, 'E70-GEX-Finished-NoOVA.rds', sep = ''))

## Adding HA binding to contig file. This is used to assign HA reactivity to BCR sequences in MiXCR separately
E70_contigs <- readRDS(file = paste(output_macos, 'E70_contigs.rds', sep = ''))
dCODE_df <- data.frame(barcode = Cells(E70_ADT.noOVA.noOverlap))
E70_contigs$barcode <- paste(E70_contigs$tagValueCELL, "-1", sep = "")


E70_contigs_filtered <- inner_join(E70_contigs, dCODE_df, by = "barcode")
E70_contigs_filtered.HC <- E70_contigs_filtered %>% filter(chains == "IGH")
E70_contigs_filtered.LC <- E70_contigs_filtered %>% filter(chains != "IGH")

E70_contigs_filtered.HC %>% mutate(HA_binding = dCODE_df$E70_ADT.noOVA.noOverlap.AgGate2)
E70_contigs_filtered.LC %>% mutate(HA_binding = dCODE_df$E70_ADT.noOVA.noOverlap.AgGate2)

E70_contigs_filtered.Both <- bind_rows(E70_contigs_filtered.HC, E70_contigs_filtered.LC)
saveRDS(E70_contigs_filtered.Both, file = paste(output_macos, 'E70_contigs.rds', sep = ''))
```

## Manual mutation counts

```{r manualMutation, echo=FALSE, fig.height=10, fig.width=10}
pattern <- "[SN][ACTGN][0-9]{2,3}[ACTGN]"

E70_contigs$nMutationsCDR1[is.na(E70_contigs$nMutationsCDR1)] <- 0
E70_contigs$nMutationsCDR2[is.na(E70_contigs$nMutationsCDR2)] <- 0
E70_contigs$nMutationsFR1[is.na(E70_contigs$nMutationsFR1)] <- 0
E70_contigs$nMutationsFR2[is.na(E70_contigs$nMutationsFR2)] <- 0
E70_contigs$nMutationsFR3[is.na(E70_contigs$nMutationsFR3)] <- 0
E70_contigs$nMutationsFR4[is.na(E70_contigs$nMutationsFR4)] <- 0

#Count occurances that match the REGEX expression for a mutation
E70_contigs$totnMutationsCDR <- str_count(E70_contigs$nMutationsCDR1, pattern = pattern) + 
                                str_count(E70_contigs$nMutationsCDR2, pattern = pattern)

E70_contigs$totnMutationsFR <-  str_count(E70_contigs$nMutationsFR1, pattern = pattern) + 
                                str_count(E70_contigs$nMutationsFR2, pattern = pattern) + 
                                str_count(E70_contigs$nMutationsFR3, pattern = pattern) +
                                str_count(E70_contigs$nMutationsFR4, pattern = pattern)


## Merging Contig mutations with Seurat object:
E70_GEX.noOVA <- readRDS(file = paste(output_macos, 'E70-GEX-Finished-NoOVA.rds', sep = ''))
E70_ADT.noOVA <- readRDS(file = paste(output_macos, 'E70-ADT-Finished-NoOVA.rds', sep = ''))


E70_mutationList <- E70_contigs
E70_mutationList$Barcode <- E70_contigs$tagValueCELL
E70_mutationList$CDR_mut <- E70_contigs$totnMutationsCDR
E70_mutationList$FWR_mut <- E70_contigs$totnMutationsFR
E70_mutationList <- E70_mutationList %>% mutate(tagValueCELL = paste(tagValueCELL, "-1", sep = ""))

Cells(E70_GEX.noOVA) %>% length()
unique(E70_mutationList$tagValueCELL) %>% length()

E70_mutationList.HC <- E70_mutationList %>% filter(chains == "IGH")
E70_mutationList.HC.ADT <- E70_mutationList.HC %>% filter(tagValueCELL %in% Cells(E70_ADT.noOVA))
E70_mutationList.HC.ADT <- arrange(E70_mutationList.HC.ADT, tagValueCELL)
E70_mutationList.HC.GEX <- E70_mutationList.HC %>% filter(tagValueCELL %in% Cells(E70_GEX.noOVA))
E70_mutationList.HC.GEX <- arrange(E70_mutationList.HC.GEX, tagValueCELL)

E70_mutationList.LC <- E70_mutationList %>% filter(chains == "IGL" | chains == "IGK")
E70_mutationList.LC.ADT <- E70_mutationList.LC %>% filter(tagValueCELL %in% Cells(E70_ADT.noOVA))
E70_mutationList.LC.ADT$tagValueCELL %>% length()
E70_mutationList.LC.ADT <- arrange(E70_mutationList.LC.ADT, tagValueCELL)
E70_mutationList.LC.GEX <- E70_mutationList.HC %>% filter(tagValueCELL %in% Cells(E70_GEX.noOVA))
E70_mutationList.LC.GEX$tagValueCELL %>% length()
E70_mutationList.LC.GEX <- arrange(E70_mutationList.LC.GEX, tagValueCELL)


nrow(E70_GEX.noOVA@meta.data)
E70_mutationList.HC$tagValueCELL %>% length()

#HC Mutations GEX
E70_GEX.noOVA@meta.data[["HC_CDR_mut"]] <- E70_mutationList.HC.GEX$totnMutationsCDR
E70_GEX.noOVA@meta.data[["HC_FWR_mut"]] <- E70_mutationList.HC.GEX$totnMutationsFR
E70_GEX.noOVA@meta.data[["HC_totMut"]] <- E70_GEX.noOVA@meta.data[["HC_FWR_mut"]] + E70_GEX.noOVA@meta.data[["HC_CDR_mut"]]

#HC Mutations ADT
E70_ADT.noOVA@meta.data[["HC_CDR_mut"]] <- E70_mutationList.HC.ADT$totnMutationsCDR
E70_ADT.noOVA@meta.data[["HC_FWR_mut"]] <- E70_mutationList.HC.ADT$totnMutationsFR
E70_ADT.noOVA@meta.data[["HC_totMut"]] <- E70_ADT.noOVA@meta.data[["HC_FWR_mut"]] + E70_ADT.noOVA@meta.data[["HC_CDR_mut"]]

#LC Mutations GEX
E70_GEX.noOVA@meta.data[["LC_CDR_mut"]] <- E70_mutationList.LC.GEX$totnMutationsCDR
E70_GEX.noOVA@meta.data[["LC_FWR_mut"]] <- E70_mutationList.LC.GEX$totnMutationsFR
E70_GEX.noOVA@meta.data[["LC_totMut"]] <- E70_GEX.noOVA@meta.data[["LC_FWR_mut"]] + E70_GEX.noOVA@meta.data[["LC_CDR_mut"]]

#LC Mutations GEX
E70_ADT.noOVA@meta.data[["LC_CDR_mut"]] <- E70_mutationList.LC.ADT$totnMutationsCDR
E70_ADT.noOVA@meta.data[["LC_FWR_mut"]] <- E70_mutationList.LC.ADT$totnMutationsFR
E70_ADT.noOVA@meta.data[["LC_totMut"]] <- E70_ADT.noOVA@meta.data[["LC_FWR_mut"]] + E70_ADT.noOVA@meta.data[["LC_CDR_mut"]]

E70_GEX.noOVA@meta.data[["totMut"]] <- E70_GEX.noOVA@meta.data[["HC_totMut"]] + E70_GEX.noOVA@meta.data[["LC_totMut"]]
E70_ADT.noOVA@meta.data[["totMut"]] <- E70_ADT.noOVA@meta.data[["HC_totMut"]] + E70_ADT.noOVA@meta.data[["LC_totMut"]]

#Separate cells into different mutations groups based on number of mutations
E70_ADT.noOVA@meta.data[["MutClass"]] <- ifelse(E70_ADT.noOVA@meta.data[["totMut"]] < 1 , "0",
                                    ifelse(E70_ADT.noOVA@meta.data[["totMut"]] > 0 & E70_ADT.noOVA@meta.data[["totMut"]] < 10, "1-10",
                                    ifelse(E70_ADT.noOVA@meta.data[["totMut"]] > 9 & E70_ADT.noOVA@meta.data[["totMut"]] < 20, "11-20", 
                                    ifelse(E70_ADT.noOVA@meta.data[["totMut"]] > 19 & E70_ADT.noOVA@meta.data[["totMut"]] < 30, "21-30", ">30"))))


E70_GEX.noOVA@meta.data[["MutClass"]] <- ifelse(E70_GEX.noOVA@meta.data[["totMut"]] < 1 , "0",
                                    ifelse(E70_GEX.noOVA@meta.data[["totMut"]] > 0 & E70_GEX.noOVA@meta.data[["totMut"]] < 10, "1-10",
                                    ifelse(E70_GEX.noOVA@meta.data[["totMut"]] > 9 & E70_GEX.noOVA@meta.data[["totMut"]] < 20, "11-20", 
                                    ifelse(E70_GEX.noOVA@meta.data[["totMut"]] > 19 & E70_GEX.noOVA@meta.data[["totMut"]] < 30, "21-30", ">30"))))


#Plot mutations on UMAPs

FeaturePlot(E70_ADT.noOVA, features = "totMut", pt.size = 0.5, order = TRUE) + 
  theme(aspect.ratio=1) +
  scale_colour_gradientn(colours = brewer.pal(n = 15, name = "BuPu"))

FeaturePlot(E70_ADT.noOVA, 
            features = "totMut", 
            pt.size = 1.5, 
            order = TRUE, 
            shape.by = "HA_binding") +
  theme(aspect.ratio=1) +
  scale_colour_gradientn(colours = brewer.pal(n = 9, name = "RdYlGn")) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(16, 17, 1, 15, 2))

plot <- DimPlot(E70_ADT.noOVA, group.by = "MutClass", pt.size = 1) + 
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("#b2871b","#919191", "#a87391", "#995266", "#c62e2e"))+
  theme(plot.title = element_blank()) +
  theme(axis.title = element_blank(), 
        axis.text = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        axis.line = element_blank(),
        aspect.ratio=1)

ggsave(filename = paste(output_macos, "E70_MutUMAP_ADT.svg", sep = ""), plot = plot)

plot <- DimPlot(E70_ADT.noOVA, group.by = "HA_binding", pt.size = 1) +

        axis.text = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        axis.line = element_blank(),
        aspect.ratio=1)

plot <- DimPlot(E70_GEX.noOVA, group.by = "MutClass", pt.size = 1) +
```

## Plotting with scRepertoire

```{r ChordDiagram, echo=FALSE, fig.height=10, fig.width=10, warning=FALSE}
E70_GEX.noOVA <- readRDS(file = paste(output_macos, 'E70-GEX-Finished-NoOVA.rds', sep = ''))
E70_ADT.noOVA <- readRDS(file = paste(output_macos, 'E70-ADT-Finished-NoOVA.rds', sep = ''))

grid.cols.ADT <- scales::hue_pal()(length(unique(E70_ADT.noOVA@active.ident)))
names(grid.cols.ADT) <- levels(E70_ADT.noOVA@active.ident)

grid.cols.GEX <- scales::hue_pal()(length(unique(E70_GEX.noOVA@active.ident)))
names(grid.cols.GEX) <- levels(E70_GEX.noOVA@active.ident)


### Chord diagram over clonal overlap - based on HA bindng
circles.ADT.HA <- getCirclize(E70_ADT.noOVA, 
                       group.by = "HA_binding")
circlize::chordDiagram(circles.ADT.HA,
                       self.link = 1, 
                       grid.col = grid.cols.ADT)

### Chord diagram over clonal overlap - based on Experimental groups
circles.ADT.ident <- getCirclize(E70_ADT.noOVA, 
                       group.by = "ident")
circlize::chordDiagram(circles.ADT.ident,
                       self.link = 1, 
                       grid.col = grid.cols.ADT)

### Chord diagram over clonal overlap - based on Cell clusters
circles.GEX.ident <- getCirclize(E70_GEX.noOVA, 
                       group.by = "ident")
circlize::chordDiagram(circles.GEX.ident,
                       self.link = 1, 
                       grid.col = grid.cols.ADT)



### Clonal expansion overlayed on ADT clustering
DimPlot(E70_ADT.noOVA, group.by = "cloneType", pt.size = 1) + 
  scale_colour_manual(values = rev(c("#919191", "#a87391", "#995266", "#c62e2e", "#b2871b")), 
                      na.value = "grey") + 
  theme(plot.title = element_blank()) & 
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 24), 
        axis.text = element_text(size = 20)) &
  theme(aspect.ratio=1)


### Clonal expansion overlayed on GEX clustering
DimPlot(E70_GEX.noOVA, group.by = "cloneType", pt.size = 0.5) + 
  scale_colour_manual(values = rev(c("#919191", "#a87391", "#995266", "#c62e2e", "#b2871b")),
                      na.value = "grey") + 
  theme(plot.title = element_blank()) & 
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 24), 
        axis.text = element_text(size = 20))&
  theme(aspect.ratio=1)


```

## Doughnut repertoire overlap plots

```{r}
#Load Bulk cell sequencing repertoire and compare with single cell seurat object
Bulk <- readRDS("/Users/eliastjarnhage/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-UniversitetetiOslo/Documents/Research/Bioinformatics/data_all_bulk.RDS")
SingleCell <- readRDS("/Users/eliastjarnhage/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-UniversitetetiOslo/Documents/Research/Bioinformatics/data_all_sc.RDS")
Bulk_SC_overlap <- readRDS("/Users/eliastjarnhage/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-UniversitetetiOslo/Documents/Research/Bioinformatics/data_all_sc_overlap.RDS")

E70_overlap <- bind_rows(Bulk_SC_overlap[["data"]][["mouse_scseq_2_hc_PBS;PBS"]], 
                         Bulk_SC_overlap[["data"]][["mouse_scseq_2_hc_PBS;CA07"]],
                         Bulk_SC_overlap[["data"]][["mouse_scseq_2_hc_CA07;CA07"]],
                         Bulk_SC_overlap[["data"]][["mouse_scseq_2_hc_PR8;CA07"]],
                         Bulk_SC_overlap[["data"]][["mouse_scseq_2_lc_PBS;PBS"]], 
                         Bulk_SC_overlap[["data"]][["mouse_scseq_2_lc_PBS;CA07"]],
                         Bulk_SC_overlap[["data"]][["mouse_scseq_2_lc_CA07;CA07"]],
                         Bulk_SC_overlap[["data"]][["mouse_scseq_2_lc_PR8;CA07"]])

E70_singleCell <- bind_rows(SingleCell[["data"]][["mouse_scseq_2_hc_PBS;PBS"]], 
                         SingleCell[["data"]][["mouse_scseq_2_hc_PBS;CA07"]],
                         SingleCell[["data"]][["mouse_scseq_2_hc_CA07;CA07"]],
                         SingleCell[["data"]][["mouse_scseq_2_hc_PR8;CA07"]],
                         SingleCell[["data"]][["mouse_scseq_2_lc_PBS;PBS"]], 
                         SingleCell[["data"]][["mouse_scseq_2_lc_PBS;CA07"]],
                         SingleCell[["data"]][["mouse_scseq_2_lc_CA07;CA07"]],
                         SingleCell[["data"]][["mouse_scseq_2_lc_PR8;CA07"]])

E70_singleCell$Overlap = FALSE
for (row in 1:nrow(E70_singleCell)) {
  E70_singleCell[row, 46] <- if_else(E70_singleCell[row, 41] %in% E70_overlap$Barcode, TRUE, FALSE)
}
unique(E70_singleCell$Barcode) %>% length()

PD = E70_singleCell %>% group_by(Overlap, Infections)
DoughnutPlot <- PieDonut(PD, aes(Overlap, Infections),
                         title = "Clonal overlap SC - Bulk",
                         r0 = 0.45, r1 = 0.9)
pdf(file = paste(output_macos, "E70_OverlapDoughnut.pdf", sep = ""))
PieDonut(PD, aes(Overlap, Infections),
                         title = "Clonal overlap SC - Bulk",
                         r0 = 0.45, r1 = 0.9)
dev.off()


PD2 = E70_singleCell %>% filter(HA.binding != "OVA") %>% group_by(Overlap, HA.binding)

pdf(file = paste(output_macos, "E70_OverlapDoughnut_HA.pdf", sep = ""))
PieDonut(PD2, aes(Overlap, HA.binding),
        title = "Clonal overlap SC - Bulk",
        r0 = 0.45, r1 = 0.9)
dev.off()
```
